node Feed "facts feed"
node Store "QuadStore (B)"
node Memory "RdfMemory (B)"
node Page "page (B)"
edge Feed sends Store "new blocks (sync)"
edge Store -> Store "apply + cursor"
edge Store sends Memory "listen(batch)"
edge Memory -> Memory "push to rules"
edge Page calls Memory "take(subscription)"
edge Memory returns Page "events"
note Memory "outbox in local part"
